no_adcom_quote.quote: This application did not require discussion at an ODAC meeting due to the fact that trial results were superior to other products for a similar disease indication and the risk/benefit was thought to be favorable.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for BLA125557 (Blincyto/blinatumomab). The Summary Review and Office Director Memo state the application did not require discussion at an ODAC meeting because trial results were superior to other products for a similar disease indication and the risk/benefit was considered favorable; the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review and Medical Review both record 'No Advisory Committee meeting' / 'There was no advisory committee for this application.' Because no AdComm was held, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval (the boxed warnings for cytokine release syndrome and neurological toxicities and the REMS communication plan arose from the review team's own safety assessment, not from a committee).
